policyTitle: White Caves Real Estate LLC — Regulatory Compliance & Corporate Governance Bylaws
jurisdiction: Dubai Land Department (DLD) & Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA)

dataOwnershipGovernance.bylaw: All client leads, contact records, viewing logs, and inquiry metadata generated via company-funded marketing webhooks or platform portals remain the 100% exclusive intellectual property of White Caves Real Estate LLC. Unauthorized export, copying, or personal retention upon contract termination constitutes a direct breach of UAE Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and RERA Regulation No. 85 of 2006.
dataOwnershipGovernance.penaltyEnforcement: Immediate revocation of Level 1-4 RBAC clearance, forfeiture of pending un-disbursed commissions, and formal escalation to RERA Legal Disciplinary Committee.

promotionalSalesSplit.name: Accelerated Agent Onboarding Support
promotionalSalesSplit.autoMigrationAction: Transition agent to Standard Performance Slab Structure based on rolling 1-quarter run-rate

tierMigrationGracePeriod.ruleDescription: A hardcoded 3-month (1-quarter) grace period buffer is enforced before any automatic downward tier reclassification is executed. During this window, the agent retains their higher tier split.
